title: Signed Cancellation Notice for Group Room Blocks
content:
A definite Group Room Blocks contract is cancelled only by the organiser's own signature on the written cancellation notice, given personally through the signing step guest services hands over in the contact; a request to cancel by phone has no effect until that signature is given, and the date it is given is the date the signed notice is received.

### What signing does

Signing the notice cancels the block on that date, releases every room night still held with the cancellation basis, and charges the cancellation damages to the master account as one damages entry. A cancellation under the elimination waiver carries no damages; every other cancellation of a definite contract is charged the cancellation damages.

| Item | After the organiser signs |
|---|---|
| Block status | cancelled, dated the day of signature |
| Room nights still held | all released, by one release entry with the cancellation basis |
| Master account | raised by the damages, posted as one damages entry |
| A phone request not yet signed | no effect |

### What the damages wait on

Cancellation damages are not worked out until each signed increase addendum on the block is matched by an increase entry on the block ledger that names it.

Cancellation damages are fixed only after the block ledger carries the cut-off release owed for a block whose cut-off date has been reached.


### Tool: sign_group_cancellation_1ea1e1e5

**Capability.** The organiser signs the written cancellation notice of their own definite group room block. The block becomes cancelled with today's date as its cancellation date; every room night still held is released to the hotel's inventory by one release entry with the cancellation basis; and the cancellation damages given are charged to the group master account by one damages entry on the block's ledger, which raises the master account balance by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-owned tool: guest services unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the organiser) signs by running it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `group_block_id` | the reference number of the organiser's group room block, which guest services reads from the group block lookup and gives to the organiser together with the damages amount | identifier |
| `damages_amount` | the cancellation damages being charged | USD, 2 decimal places, a non-negative amount rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success: `status` "cancelled", `group_block_id`, `cancelled_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `release_entry_id` (reference number of the release entry), `room_nights_released` (whole room nights released on cancellation), `damages_entry_id` (reference number of the damages entry), `damages_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `master_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, the master account balance after the charge).
